items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know the song. It sounds so familiar when you sing it. [SOUNDED LIKE TIZOL'S "MOONLIGHT FIESTA"]

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, I figured he'd like that, and he did -- he liked it. But I can't think of the name of it.
I know the song. It sounds so familiar when you sing it. [SOUNDED LIKE TIZOL'S "MOONLIGHT FIESTA"]
